 SK hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) Shares Climb 9.7% - Still a Buy?
 Written by MarketBeat November 11, 2026 Add As Preferred Source Share Share Share This Article Link copied to clipboard. Close 
 Image from MarketBeat Media, LLC. 
 Key Points
 SK hynix shares rose 9.7% to $142.25, with trading volume 24% below the average.
 Analyst sentiment is broadly positive: the consensus rating is Buy , with a $247.80 average price target; 14 analysts rate the stock Buy or Strong Buy, while two rate it Hold.
 Quarterly results were mixed: EPS of $3.84 missed the $5.96 consensus estimate, while revenue of $73.86 billion exceeded expectations of $66.41 billion.
 Interested in SK hynix? Here are five stocks we like better . 
 Shares of SK hynix Inc. ( NASDAQ:SKHY - Get Free Report ) rose 9.7% on Wednesday. The company traded as high as $145.79 and last traded at $142.25. 20,132,588 shares were traded during trading, a decline of 24% from the average daily volume of 26,522,074 shares. The stock had previously closed at $129.66. Get SK hynix alerts: Sign Up Analysts Set New Price Targets
 South Korea's Chip Exports Are Soaring—So Why Is This ETF Down 20%? 
 Several research firms have issued reports on SKHY. UBS Group began coverage on shares of SK hynix in a research note on Wednesday, July 29th. They set a "buy" rating and a $204.00 price objective for the company. Weiss Ratings started coverage on shares of SK hynix in a report on Friday, October 2nd. They set a "hold (c)" rating on the stock. Stifel Nicolaus initiated coverage on shares of SK hynix in a report on Tuesday, August 4th. They set a "buy" rating and a $240.00 target price on the stock. Citigroup raised shares of SK hynix to a "strong-buy" rating in a research report on Wednesday, September 2nd. Finally, Needham & Company LLC increased their price target on SK hynix from $220.00 to $235.00 and gave the company a "buy" rating in a report on Wednesday, October 28th. Four analysts have rated the stock with a Strong Buy rating, ten have given a Buy rating and two have issued a Hold rating to the stock. According to MarketBeat.com, the company has an average rating of "Buy" and a consensus price target of $247.80.

 The stock has a market cap of $1.04 trillion and a price-to-earnings ratio of 11.26. The company's 50 day simple moving average is $165.56. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.06, a current ratio of 2.59 and a quick ratio of 2.29. 
 SK hynix ( NASDAQ:SKHY - Get Free Report ) last released its quarterly earnings results on Wednesday, October 28th. The memory chip maker reported $3.84 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, missing the consensus estimate of $5.96 by ($2.12). The company had revenue of $73.86 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts' expectations of $66.41 billion. On average, sell-side analysts anticipate that SK hynix Inc. will post 25.24 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. Institutional Trading of SK hynix

 A number of hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of the business. Ramsey Quantitative Systems purchased a new position in SK hynix in the third quarter valued at about $30,000. Richardson Financial Services Inc. purchased a new stake in SK hynix during the 3rd quarter worth approximately $50,000. Covestor Ltd purchased a new stake in SK hynix during the 3rd quarter worth approximately $60,000. Morse Asset Management Inc acquired a new position in shares of SK hynix in the 3rd quarter valued at approximately $74,000. Finally, Silver Grove Financial Group Inc. acquired a new position in shares of SK hynix in the 3rd quarter valued at approximately $80,000. SK hynix Company Profile
 ( Get Free Report ) SK hynix is a South Korean semiconductor company that develops and manufactures memory products for use in computers, mobile devices, data centers and other electronics. Its principal products include dynamic random-access memory (DRAM), NAND flash memory and high-bandwidth memory (HBM), as well as complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensors. The company's memory products support applications ranging from personal computing and smartphones to servers, artificial intelligence systems and automotive electronics. Recommended Stories
